description:
"Gye Chun-hee" was trying to leave Korea with the money she had accumulated during her long part-time job.  
However, she accidentally touches the Imoogi's Yeouiju* three months before her ascension, and for unknown reasons, the Yeouiju enters Chunhee's body.  
"Your Yeouiju entered my body?!"  
Cheon-hee tried to leave Korea, but she said that she would not be able to leave Korea until she ascended to heaven.  
"But it wouldn't be too bad, right? Yeouiju brings good luck."  
Mu-ryong proposes to Chun-hee to live together for three months before ascending to heaven, and Chun-hee reluctantly accepts it...  
Thus, the brave coexistence of humans and Imoogi begins. MTL

*Yeouiju is korean dragon spirit orb.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=808791), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=9681654)
